purpose: Records every authorized, fingerprint-only regeneration of tests/benchmark/results/BASELINE-001-REV-1/results.json (a change to scoring-v101.js's own file bytes, with zero change to any per-item v1.0.1 outcome). tests/benchmark/rev2/stage-gate-subset-v1.json - the frozen 30-item stage-gate set - is never touched by these migrations; its derivedFrom.resultsSha256 is a historical pin to the exact REV-1 snapshot it was originally selected from, not a live pointer expected to track every later scorer refresh. This file exists so that divergence between the frozen subset's historical pin and REV-1's current self-hash is an explicit, documented, tested fact - not an unexplained mismatch.

migrations.reason: F9 fix to scoreContradiction (tests/benchmark/rev1/scoring-v101.js), diagnosed for CT-01 (GROUNDED-002, PASS->PARTIAL): a correct, fully-resolving answer used the construction 'not X, as stated in Y' rather than an 'is incorrect/inconsistent' marker word, so `flagged` never fired. Scoped to scoreContradiction only; does not touch the shared CONFLICT_MARKERS list read by other categories.
migrations.itemOutcomeDrift: none - verified by direct comparison: every one of the 152 v1.0.1 per-item outcomes (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/ERROR) in BASELINE-001-REV-1 is byte-identical before and after this migration. The new correction-construction pattern matches zero items in the frozen 152-item baseline; it only ever fires on CT-01's separate, later GROUNDED-002 live-run answer (a different piece of text, read and rescored offline, never written into any frozen baseline file). Only REV-1's own embedded scorerV101Sha256 fingerprint - and therefore REV-1's own file hash - changed.
migrations.frozenSubsetImpact: tests/benchmark/rev2/stage-gate-subset-v1.json is not modified by this migration. Its derivedFrom.resultsSha256 correctly continues to record the PRIOR (priorResultsSha256 above) REV-1 snapshot as the historical origin of the frozen 30-item selection - this is intended, not drift, and is explicitly tested (tests/benchmark/scoring-v102.test.js).
